cure

(noun). chữa trị

There's still no cure for cancer.

contravene

(verb). làm gì đó trái pháp luật

The company was found guilty of contravening safety regulations.

unorthodox

(adjective). không chính thống

His methods have been criticized as somewhat unorthodox.

practice

(noun). ứng dụng thực tiễn

She's determined to put her new ideas into practice.

law

(noun). luật pháp

The company's actions violated the law on equal employment.

harmful

(adjective). làm tổn thương

Many household products are potentially harmful.

heterodox

(adjective). không chính thống

His opinions have always been distinctly heterodox.

academic

(noun). học giả

She had a brilliant academic career.

staff

(noun). nhân viên

The hospital staff cared for me so well.

subject

(noun). đối tượng con người

Nelson Mandela is the subject of a new biography.

professor

(noun). giáo sư

He was made (a) professor at the age of 40.

lecturer

(noun). người diễn thuyết

Dr David Crystal is our visiting lecturer today.

clinical

(adjective). lâm sàng

She regarded her patients from a purely clinical standpoint.

practitioner

(noun). tập sự

Elizabeth Quan is a London-based practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.

pharmacist

(noun). dược sĩ

We had to wait for the pharmacist to make up her prescription.

train

(verb). huấn luyện

Specially trained coaches will provide support at no extra charge.

acupuncture

(noun). châm cứu

Needles are inserted into specific acupuncture points in the body.

exorcism

(noun). lời phù phép, câu thần chú

A priest performed an exorcism and afterwards the ghost disappeared.

therapy

(noun). trị liệu

He is receiving therapy for cancer.

wealthy

(adjective). giàu

The deal is about to make him a very wealthy man.

welfare

(noun). phúc lợi

We are concerned about the child's welfare.

citizen

(noun). công dân

The interests of British citizens living abroad are protected by the British Embassy.

healthy

(adjective). khoẻ mạnh

She's a normal, healthy child.

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

We were encouraged to learn foreign languages at school.

fraudulent

(adjective). gian lận

A worrying trend for insurers has been a rise in fraudulent claims.

manner

(noun). cách hành xử

It is bad manners to talk with your mouth full.

ordinary

(adjective). bình thường

This was no ordinary meeting.

criminal

(adjective). có tội

The former minister could face criminal proceedings over his involvement in the deal.

patient

(noun). bệnh nhân

Hospitals are treating more patients than ever before.

adhere

(verb). bám chặt vào

Once in the bloodstream, the bacteria adhere to the surface of the red cells.

procedure

(noun). thủ tục, thể thức

court/legal/parliamentary procedure

legal

(adjective). thuộc về pháp luật

They are currently facing a long legal battle in the US courts.

statute

(noun). đạo luật

Penalties are laid down in the statute.

accordance

(noun). sự phù hợp, sự theo đúng (cái gì)

We acted in accordance with my parents’ wishes.

reference

(noun). dẫn chứng

Her book contains many biblical references.

practical

(adjective). thực tiễn

He offered her some practical advice.

pharmaceutical

(adjective). thuộc dược phẩm

My family owns a pharmaceutical company.

purely

(adverb). thuần

She took the job purely and simply for the money.

pragmatic

(adjective). thực dụng

They're pragmatic about the spending cuts.

theoretical

(adjective). mang tính lý thuyết

The first year provides students with a sound theoretical basis for later study.

consideration

(noun). sự xem xét

Careful consideration should be given to issues of health and safety.

influence

(verb). có sức cảnh hưởng

His writings have influenced the lives of millions.

origin

(noun). nguồn gốc

The origin of the word remains obscure.

knowledge

(noun). kiến thức

It will be an opportunity to gain knowledge and experience.

ailment

(noun). bệnh nhẹ

I got all the usual childhood ailments.

literary

(adjective). liên quan tới văn học

She has been described as the creative colossus of the literary world.

tradition

(noun). truyền thống

This region is steeped in tradition.

document

(verb). ghi nhận

Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.

substance

(noun). vật chất

Psychoactive drugs are chemical substances that act on the brain.

prescription

(noun). đơn thuốc

The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.

illness

(noun). bệnh tật

The virus can cause illness in humans.

physician

(noun). thầy thuốc

Please consult your physician before beginning any new exercise program.

ethical

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

She objected on purely ethical grounds.

elaborate

(adjective). kỹ lưỡng

She had prepared a very elaborate meal.

compose

(verb). tạo thành

Ten people compose the committee.

produce

(verb). sản xuất

Our company mainly produces goods for export.

counterpart

(noun). bản đối chiếu

The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.

dynasty

(noun). triều đại

The civil service was established under the previous dynasty.

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

The point of my question may not be immediately apparent.

provincial

(adjective). thuộc về tỉnh, cấp tỉnh

The majority of young professionals in the capital have moved there from provincial towns.

populace

(noun). đại chúng

He had the support of large sections of the local populace.

cataract

(noun). bệnh đục nhân mắt

A cataract is a clouding of the normally clear lens of your eye.

intellectual

(adjective). về mặt trí tuệ

She's extremely bright, but not really intellectual.

summon

(verb). triệu tập ai đó lên toà

He was summoned to appear before the magistrates.

correspondence

(noun). thư từ

The editor welcomes correspondence from readers on any subject.

paramount

(adjective). có tầm quan trọng lớn nhất; có ý nghĩa lớn nhất; tột bậc

This matter is of paramount importance.

obligation

(noun). nghĩa vụ

You are under no obligation to buy anything.

justification

(noun). sự bào chữa, biện hộ

I can see no possible justification for any further tax increases.
